description: Ex-Australian Army Sioux; ADF-Serials: currently on display at the Vietnam Veterans Museum, Newhaven.
Delivered from Oakey in June 2012; displayed configured as a Bushranger gunship.
Won by the museum in the 2015-16 Commonwealth disposal of retired Caribou; ex-Brisbane Airport storage.
Second Caribou acquired by the museum in the same 2015-16 disposal; ex-Oakey storage.
Acquired from Caboolture and delivered to Newhaven 15 February 2018; incomplete airframe, now fitted with a door marked 07.
Ex-Royal Australian Navy Wessex; ADF-Serials places it at the Vietnam Veterans Museum, Newhaven.
Second ex-RAN Wessex on display at Newhaven.
Ex-Royal Australian Navy Tracker acquired November 2013; on outside display at the front of the museum.
The world oldest surviving Canberra; purchased by the museum, moved from San Remo to Newhaven and under intensive restoration inside the display hangar.
US-supplied Cobra gunship displayed in the Vietnam galleries; individual serial not established.
